notes.title: NightFeed Update v1.3
notes.notes:
-Added New Character "Fire Queen"
-Homing bullets will now do damage to boss
-Quests added to Dark Village Map
-Storm less likely to appear after quest is given
-Added closer exit to Dungeon map - so Players can find way outside quicker
-No Red Storm in first 5 minutes of Dungeon map
-Put broken walls in line of sight of player for less obstructed view
-Possibly fixed performance issues in Dungeon? (changed a couple things... but still need to test)
-Dead Enemies can no longer shoot projectiles
-Fixed non-transparent doorways in Dungeon/Dark Village Maps so player can see potions inside better
-No Silver Bullets Message after 4th message
-Chests Count up Gold before opening 
-Plus other misc changes

Update version 1.2
--------------------

- FIXED Vampire's minions can no longer block player
- FIXED Characters no longer get stuck on ice
- FIXED Options menu not working when in a level up screen
- ADDED 2 more upbeat music tracks to Desert Ruins map

notes.title: Update 1.1 for NightFeed
notes.notes:
Thanks everyone who left a review for NightFeed. It really helps when players leave reviews.

Version 1.1 update

- NEW Artifact "Golden Egg" - 50% more gold from small gold piles
- NEW Artifact "Shop Tokens" - 20% discount in shop
- NEW Artifact "Bomb Beacon" - Bombs emit a beam into the sky so see easier
- NEW Artifact "Magic Dice" - Allows re-rolls during levelup
- NEW Artifact "Regen Spice" - Allow auto regeneration up to 20%

- FIXED - Healer now heals up to 75% not just 75 health
- FIXED - Vampire can no longer shoot his Raven skill when killed
